chibi-candy-monument.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:CANDY
chibi-candy-monument.notes: Reused candidate 2 of the Candy Explorer sheet (explorer-a), no new PixelLab job (the US$5 limit left no room for obelisk-a). A stepped milk chocolate obelisk dotted with pale pink sprinkles and one pale pink sparkle star on its front, on a low chocolate plinth: the sprinkles and star the obelisk recipe asked for, no compass rose. A small rolled wafer lies along the right of its plinth (the spyglass of the Explorer prompt, two pixels high at 1:1 and not read as one). Lit from the left. Every other piece carries a caramel rose, a sparkle beside a frosted tip with a leaning wafer spyglass, or a pink obelisk (11) with the spyglass leaning on it.

chibi-candy-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:CANDY:CONQUEROR
chibi-candy-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a small triumphal arch of milk chocolate with cream frosting on its lintel and an open gateway, a big golden caramel laurel wreath on top and a crossed candy-cane sword and spear on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath in Candy chocolate and caramel, lit from the left. 1, 3, 9 and 15 dark chocolate; 2, 4 and 14 white; 7, 11 and 13 pink; 8, 11, 14 and 15 have owner key red pixels.
